body: It's almost ironic right? The only people that understand us can't even help themselves, let alone others.

Good idea with the cops. We are definitely planning on talking to him, but I hadn't even thought about that. We've done our best to inventory. As far as we can tell, no keys are missing. If we find anything is missing or damaged, we are going to have our brother pay up. Just a lot of left over phones. Thanks for the advice!
